title: Joining Paloma Rewards: Enrollment Conditions and Starting Tier
content:
A customer can enroll in Paloma Rewards only while their Personal Sender Account is active; Paloma Business accounts cannot enroll.

## The enrollment rule

- **Account condition.** The condition is read from the status of the customer's Personal Sender Account in Paloma's records before the enrollment is made; only the status active satisfies it. A Paloma Business account does not satisfy it.
- **Starting tier.** The starting tier is the highest tier whose qualifying-transfer count or qualifying principal volume the customer already meets, measured over the trailing 12 months, and Paloma Rewards Blue otherwise. The tier takes effect on the enrollment date.
- **First review date.** The next tier review date is the enrollment date plus the tier review interval, counted in calendar months.
- **Referral code.** A referral code is recorded only when it is entered at enrollment and only when it belongs to another member's active membership. It is recorded exactly as entered, together with the customer who owns it; when no code is entered, both are left empty. A code entered later is never applied.
- **Earlier transfers.** Transfers completed before enrollment earn no points.

## The trailing-12-month measures used for the starting tier

- The qualifying-transfer count is the number of the customer's personal transfers (Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup, Mobile Wallet) whose principal is at or above the smallest qualifying principal, that reached deposited, paid out or credited with a delivery date on or after the same calendar day 12 months before the enrollment date, and that are not refunded.
- The qualifying principal volume is the total USD principal of those same transfers.

Meeting either one of a tier's two thresholds is enough for that tier.

## Worked illustration (invented thresholds)

Suppose a higher tier required 10 transfers or USD 5,000 and a lower tier required 4 transfers or USD 2,000. A customer with 6 qualifying transfers totalling USD 5,200 meets the higher tier by volume, though not by count, and starts on the higher tier. A customer with 3 qualifying transfers totalling USD 900 meets neither and starts on Paloma Rewards Blue.

Dates (hypothetical): with a 12-month review interval, enrollment on 15 March 2026 gives a starting tier effective 15 March 2026 and a next tier review date of 15 March 2027.

## Points of judgement

| Situation in the records | Outcome under this rule |
|---|---|
| Personal Sender Account status other than active | No enrollment |
| Customer holding only a Paloma Business account | No enrollment |
| Referral code entered at enrollment, owned by a member whose membership is active | Code and owner recorded |
| Referral code entered at enrollment, owner's membership not active | Code not recorded |
| Referral code offered after enrollment | Never applied |
| Transfer delivered the day before enrollment | Earns no points |
